notes:
Sphere Bot v1.0.15

- Gentle Curve faces with realistic material and stable eye size across expressions and gaze.
- Searchable, organized desktop settings and cleaner account/dashboard settings.
- Interactive website product demo with whole messages, file previews and fitted computer scenes.
- Account Codex model and reasoning selectors, plus redesigned sign-in and signup.
- Reliable Restart and update shutdown, scoped local process cleanup and Sphere-branded update progress.
- Disposable-email registration protection using a maintained domain list, with administrator controls to block existing accounts and pause their cloud computers.
- Recovery of owned computers already paused during prior cleanup.

The Microsoft Store update is submitted separately and becomes available after Microsoft certification.
